project-details.title: Luminary
project-details.subtitle: Case Study
project-details.body: The core challenge was making AI feel personal, not clinical. I fine-tuned prompt chains to mirror the user's own vocabulary back to them in insights, which lifted 7-day retention by 28% compared to generic summaries. The biggest technical hurdle was streaming OpenAI responses into a real-time editor without layout shift — solved with a custom ReadableStream hook and a debounced DOM patch strategy.

project-details.title: Orbit Design System
project-details.subtitle: Case Study
project-details.body: Three separate product teams were shipping inconsistent UIs. I audited 1,200+ components across codebases, distilled them into 60 primitives, and introduced a Figma token pipeline that kept design and code in sync automatically. Adoption went from 0 to 100% across all products in six weeks, cutting design-to-dev handoff time by half.

project-details.title: PulseMetrics
project-details.subtitle: Case Study
project-details.body: Indie makers were drowning in tabs — Stripe dashboard, Paddle reports, spreadsheets. I built a unified ingestion layer that normalises revenue events across providers into a single schema, then layered Recharts visualisations on top. The hardest part was reconciling timezone-offset discrepancies in Paddle's legacy webhook payloads — a bug that took three days to isolate and one line to fix.
